scope: All recoverable saved training corpora listed below, including later offline demonstrations/scaling pools. Available supervision is not proof that every row was used in every optimizer run. rfbc_7b.sampling: Uniform degree>=10 root then seeded shuffled outgoing BFS; sample fixed before training or scoring

large_graph_8d.sampling: Same8B seeded random-frontier growth with up to8 fresh outgoing neighbors;10000 unseen articles; all induced edges; no performance-based resampling

data.sampling_note: B1 samples forward action records without replacement; B2 samples paired-pool shortest actions with replacement to match B1 goal counts exactly; B3 substitutes exactly half the aligned B1/B2 records, preserving the same goal histogram
data.terminal_note: Walks allow repeats. Endpoint chooses goal; supervision stops at its first occurrence, and zero-action cycles are discarded. This is an explicit episodic modification to raw fixed-length forward-walk cloning.

data.scope: Exact candidate distances in the saved directed million graph; destination-disjoint splits. Only a sample of decisions is supervised, not every article pair.

record.scope: Training mistakes only, no validation/test mistakes

record.criterion: Mean normalized trapezoid success AUC over log expansion budget, across3 searches; tie shortest AUC, lower mean expansions at100, simpler mode, lower maximum weight. No test reselection.

gaps: Original checkpoints do not all persist exact optimizer minibatch visits; this bundle preserves source corpora and saved selection metadata rather than claiming byte-for-byte replay of every update.

Large raw dumps, pretrained encoder weights, feature tensors and full million-node edge graphs remain local. Rebuilding them requires the original snapshot or new collection, which is a different dataset.
